back.en: Thin, moist, large surface area, rich blood supply
back.bm: Nipis, lembap, luas permukaan besar, banyak bekalan darah

back.en: Spiracles → tracheae → tracheoles delivering O₂ directly to cells
back.bm: Spirakel → trakea → trakeol yang menghantar O₂ terus ke sel

back.en: Many filaments and lamellae; countercurrent flow of water and blood
back.bm: Banyak filamen dan lamela; aliran arus lawan antara air dan darah

back.en: External intercostals + diaphragm contract → volume ↑ pressure ↓ → air in
back.bm: Interkosta luar + diafragma mengecut → isi padu ↑ tekanan ↓ → udara masuk

back.en: External intercostals + diaphragm relax → volume ↓ pressure ↑ → air out
back.bm: Interkosta luar + diafragma mengendur → isi padu ↓ tekanan ↑ → udara keluar

back.en: One-cell-thick wall, moist, huge total surface area, surrounded by capillaries
back.bm: Dinding setebal satu sel, lembap, jumlah luas permukaan sangat besar, dikelilingi kapilari

back.en: As oxyhaemoglobin in red blood cells
back.bm: Sebagai oksihemoglobin dalam sel darah merah

back.en: Mostly as hydrogen carbonate ions (HCO₃⁻) in plasma
back.bm: Kebanyakannya sebagai ion hidrogen karbonat (HCO₃⁻) dalam plasma

back.en: Moist skin (at rest and underwater), lungs and buccal cavity lining
back.bm: Kulit lembap (semasa rehat dan dalam air), peparu dan lapisan rongga bukal

back.en: Asthma, bronchitis, emphysema, lung cancer, pneumonia
back.bm: Asma, bronkitis, emfisema, kanser peparu, pneumonia

back.en: Tar (cancer), carbon monoxide (less O₂), nicotine (addiction), irritants (damage cilia)
back.bm: Tar (kanser), karbon monoksida (kurang O₂), nikotina (ketagihan), perengsa (rosakkan silia)

back.en: PM2.5 particles irritate airways; wear N95 masks and stay indoors when the API is high
back.bm: Zarah PM2.5 merengsa saluran pernafasan; pakai topeng N95 dan duduk di dalam rumah apabila IPU tinggi

back.en: Inhaled: about 21% O₂, 0.04% CO₂. Exhaled: about 16% O₂, 4% CO₂, more water vapour
back.bm: Sedutan: kira-kira 21% O₂, 0.04% CO₂. Hembusan: kira-kira 16% O₂, 4% CO₂, lebih banyak wap air

back.en: O₂ moves from the alveoli (high partial pressure) into the blood (low); CO₂ moves the opposite way
back.bm: O₂ bergerak dari alveolus (tekanan separa tinggi) ke darah (rendah); CO₂ bergerak ke arah sebaliknya

back.en: Gases diffuse across the whole plasma membrane — its large surface area to volume ratio is enough
back.bm: Gas meresap merentasi seluruh membran plasma — nisbah luas permukaan kepada isi padu yang besar sudah mencukupi
